steps.title: Tuning
steps.text: The tune is the heart of the build. Pick the tuning platform you want to run: EZ LYNK or HP Tuners. Your tune is custom written for your truck and the parts you choose below. Add transmission tuning here if you want it.

options.name: EZ LYNK Custom Tuning Support Package
options.note: Limited is a 4-week support window. Full is longer support.

options.name: HP Tuners Custom Tuning
options.note: Choose your level, credits and transmission tuning.

steps.title: Delete Pipe
steps.text: The pipe that replaces the factory emissions section between the turbo and the exhaust.

steps.title: EGR
steps.text: EGR kit. Optional. Skip it if you don't need it.
